verdict.rationale: Canva documents an official command line tool, referenced in its Apps quickstart, but it is scoped to creating and managing Canva apps rather than driving designs, exports, or assets from the terminal. Agent-facing design operations are exposed through the MCP server and Connect APIs, not the CLI. Missing for 10: CLI coverage of core design and asset workflows, detailed command reference, scripting/agent-oriented usage docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
